phase: Phase 16: Offline Vector Terrain & Trail Map Overlay

stories.title: Pure KMP Offline Vector Trail & Terrain Geometry Engine
stories.description: Implement pure KMP domain models (VectorMapModels.kt), local projection math, trail/waypoint parsers (TrailMapEngine.kt), and reactive state coordinator (TrailMapManager.kt) in app/sharedLogic/src/commonMain/kotlin/org/nowni/intercom_alpha/map/. Supports GeoPoints, trail polylines, elevation contours, waypoint breadcrumbs, and radar projection relative to user GPS heading with zero external map library dependencies.
acceptanceCriteria: Pure KMP implementation with zero Java, C, or proprietary map SDK dependencies (Rules 2 & 3)
Calculates equirectangular/flat-earth radar projections with distance bounds (500m, 1.5km, 5km)
Parses lightweight GeoJSON/JSON trail tracks and waypoints into typed polylines and markers
Maintains rolling breadcrumb trails for local rider and mesh convoy peers
100% unit test pass on JVM and iOS Simulator targets

stories.title: Subsystem Bridge Wiring & Reactive Presentation Integration
stories.description: Wire TrailMapManager into Koin DI, IntercomHardwareBridge, AndroidPlatformBridge, and IntercomBridge (iosMain) with typed CancellationHandle observers. Integrate into HomeUiState.kt and HomeViewModel.kt, managing trail snapshot, selectable radar zoom ranges (500m, 1.5km, 5km), trail overlay toggles, and waypoint creation.
acceptanceCriteria: Exposes reactive StateFlow<TrailMapSnapshot> across hardware bridges and ViewModels
Provides swift-friendly observeTrailMapSnapshot callback with CancellationHandle lifecycle (Rule 1)
HomeViewModel coordinates GPS location changes to TrailMapManager for dynamic projection
Full test pass in sharedUI and sharedLogic modules

stories.title: Compose Multiplatform Radar Topo Contour & Vector Trail Overlay
stories.description: Upgrade ProximityRadarView.kt in app/sharedUI to render subtle topographic contour lines, neon trail polylines, and waypoint icons directly beneath the radar rings. Add radar range toggle button (0.5k / 1.5k / 5k) and an expandable OfflineTrailCockpitSheet.kt displaying trail profile, elevation stats, and waypoint roster.
acceptanceCriteria: Renders projected trail polylines and elevation contours under radar canvas without jank or allocations
OfflineTrailCockpitSheet displays active trail name, elevation gain, distance, and nearest waypoint
Preserves single-viewport zero-scroll mobile handlebar layout constraint

stories.title: Native iOS SwiftUI Radar Topographic Overlay & Offline Trail Cockpit Sheet
stories.description: Implement 100% native SwiftUI radar topographic contours and vector trail overlay in TacticalVectorRadarView (ContentView.swift) and OfflineTrailCockpitSheet.swift in app/iosApp (Rule 1). Wire IntercomViewModel observers with CancellationHandle, supporting radar range zoom, elevation difference badges, and offline waypoint list.
acceptanceCriteria: 100% native SwiftUI with zero Compose Multiplatform imports (Rule 1)
Draws vector trail paths and contour arcs using SwiftUI Path on TacticalVectorRadarView
Adds OfflineTrailCockpitSheet with elevation profile and nearest waypoint navigation
Full compilation and automated verification pass across all targets
